response.explanation: ActiveModel::Serializer only calls conditional-include hooks named include_<attr>?. The change defines `include_website_name` with no `?`, so the serializer never calls it. The same file uses the correct form for `include_email?` and `include_card_image_badge_id?`. As a result `website_name` is always serialized, including when the user has no website. The guard `website.present?` has no effect.
